Meta.description: Kaviyadevan Nursery Garden in Dharmapuri. Browse herbal, flowering and fruit plants in English and Tamil. Online ordering is still being prepared.

Demo.label: Demo catalogue
Demo.body: Prices, stock, photographs and Tamil wording on this preview are sample development data. They are waiting for the nursery to confirm.

Home.title: Plants for homes in and around Dharmapuri.
Home.lede: Browse herbal, flowering and fruit plants, read draft care notes, and keep a wishlist or cart on this device. Online payment is not open yet.
Home.photoNote: Illustration placeholder. Nursery photographs will replace these.
Home.categoriesLede: The first catalogue is planned across these groups. The plants below are a sample, not the full 30–50 product list.
Home.featuredLede: A few plants picked so the shop layout can be reviewed. Featuring will be chosen by the nursery later.
Home.careLede: Short guides for watering, light and potting. They are drafts for the owner to correct.
Home.storyBody: Kaviyadevan Nursery Garden is building an online shop for local customers. The owner is Kaviya Devendhiran. This website introduces the plants and the way orders are planned to work.
Home.areasBody: The initial areas under discussion are Dharmapuri Town, Vallampalli, Palacode and Harur. Wider delivery across Tamil Nadu is a later hope. These names are not a delivery promise.
Home.dispatchBody: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday are the planned dispatch days, with an estimated 1–3 days after dispatch. Both the days and the estimate still need confirmation.
Home.enquiryBody: WhatsApp is the planned way to enquire. The number, email and Instagram profile have not been added yet.

Shop.title: Shop
Shop.lede: Search by the English or Tamil plant name. Sample prices are marked, and out-of-stock plants stay out of the cart.
Shop.emptyBody: Try another name, or clear the search to see this group again.

Cart.title: Cart

Wishlist.title: Wishlist
Wishlist.lede: Saved in this browser only. No account is required.
Wishlist.emptyBody: Save a plant from its page and it will stay on this device.

Care.title: Plant care
Care.lede: Short drafts about watering, light and pots. They are not a guarantee of plant health.

About.title: Kaviyadevan Nursery Garden
About.lede: A plant nursery in Dharmapuri, Tamil Nadu, building a bilingual shop for local customers.
About.story: The nursery is known as KDN Nursery. Kaviya Devendhiran is the owner. The website is meant to help people find plants, understand basic care, and later place an online order or ask a question on WhatsApp.
About.localBody: Pickup at the nursery is planned. The street address, map location and pickup hours are not published yet. Delivery charges will follow an owner-approved order-value table. Free delivery is not part of the current plan.
About.paymentBody: Online payment through Razorpay is planned. Cash on delivery is not planned. Guest checkout is planned, so a customer account will not be required for the first release. None of that is open in this preview.

Contact.title: Talk to the nursery
Contact.lede: WhatsApp is the primary channel once the number is confirmed. Email, Instagram and the full address are still to be added.
Contact.visitBody: Store visits are welcome once the nursery publishes the address and hours. Please do not rely on a map pin from this page.

Policies.draft: Draft structure. This is not a published legal policy.

delivery.title: Delivery
paragraphs: Delivery areas, charges and timing are not final. The areas being discussed are Dharmapuri Town, Vallampalli, Palacode and Harur.
Charges are planned to follow an order-value table approved by the owner. Free delivery is not currently planned. Serviceable pincodes have not been published.
Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday are planned dispatch days. An estimate of 1–3 days is under discussion. Neither figure is a commitment yet.
Nursery pickup is planned. The address, hours and instructions will be added after they are confirmed.

privacy.title: Privacy
paragraphs: This draft explains the kinds of information a future order form may ask for: a name, phone number, delivery address and payment reference.
The wishlist and cart in this preview stay on your device. They are not sent to the nursery.
A reviewed privacy notice will be published before customer details are collected for orders.

terms.title: Terms
paragraphs: The shop preview shows sample plants so the website can be reviewed. Sample prices and stock are not an offer to sell.
When ordering opens, the server will calculate the price, delivery charge and total. A figure stored in the browser will not decide the amount payable.
These terms are a placeholder for a document the nursery will have reviewed before launch.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and plant condition
paragraphs: The nursery has discussed strict handling of cancellation and replacement after payment. That discussion is not published here as a customer promise.
Before checkout opens, the cancellation, refund, replacement and damaged-plant terms need a proper review, including consumer-protection requirements.
This page will be replaced with the reviewed wording. It does not say that refunds or replacements are refused.
